# Copilot instructions for agent-toolkit

This repository is owned by the **product-gh-external-developer-docs-admin** team at Vipps MobilePay.

## Project conventions

- Follow the existing code style and patterns already present in the repository.
- Keep changes minimal and focused on the task at hand.
- Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones unless the task clearly requires it.
- Do not introduce new dependencies without a clear reason.

## Reviews and PRs

- All changes go through pull requests targeting `main`.
- PRs require at least one approving review and passing required checks.
- Code owners must approve changes to files they own.

## Further guidance

Update this file as the project's conventions evolve. See the internal developer documentation for organization-wide guidelines.
